summary: Iteration 20 — Versements Admin, Relevé Automatique (email code path), Classement Partenaires. BACKEND: 12/12 pytest tests PASS (test_iteration20.py, gw0/gw1). Verified end-to-end: (1) POST /api/company/wallet/payout — amount=5 → 422, amount=999999 → 400, amount=10 with sufficient balance → 200 {ok:true}, wallet debited, and a matching db.payouts row is written with status='pending' and user_id/amount set. (2) GET /api/company/admin/payouts?status=pending as chauffeur@test.com (is_moderator=true) → 200 with shape {payouts[], pending_count, pending_total}; every returned payout has status='pending'; as hotel.ritz@test.com → 403 'Réservé aux administrateurs'. (3) PATCH /api/company/admin/payouts/{id} {status:'paid'} → 200 with status='paid'; a second PATCH on the same id → 409 'Cette demande a déjà été traitée'; {status:'rejected'} on a fresh pending row → 200, hotel wallet balance increased by exactly the payout amount (+10.00 €), and a wallet_tx of type 'payout_refund' is created. (4) GET /api/company/ranking → 200 with {rank, total_partners, commissioned_partners, my_total, leaderboard[], best_months[]}; hotel.ritz shows my_total>0 and rank≥1. (5) GET /api/company/commission-statements/{user_id}.pdf?month=YYYY-MM&sig=<valid HMAC(JWT_SECRET,'statement:uid:month')[:32]> → 200 application/pdf (%PDF magic); wrong sig → 403; missing sig → 403. (6) Monthly email code path — routes.company.monthly_statement_sweep and emailer.send_partner_statement are importable coroutines; sweep marks last_statement_month per partner (idempotent) and only sends when there are commission lines for the previous month (the actual send is logged when EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY missing per system contract). FRONTEND (390×844 mobile viewport, tested via Playwright): (A) Admin UI — logged in as chauffeur@test.com, navigated to /(driver)/profile: 'open-payouts-admin' present, tap opens the 'payouts-admin' sheet. Filters payout-filter-pending and payout-filter-all both present and functional (pending shows 1 card '10.00 €' with pay/reject buttons; toggling to 'all' shows the 5 seeded rows including previously-paid). Tap on 'payout-pay-<id>' fires window.confirm 'Marquer comme réglé · Hôtel Ritz Paris · 10.00 € ?' → confirmed → server 200 → the list refreshes, pending pay-btns count drops from 1 to 0. (B) Ranking card — logged in as hotel.ritz@test.com, navigated to /(company)/profile, tapped 'open-commissions': the 'partner-commissions' sheet opens, the 'comm-ranking' card is rendered with the trophy icon, '#1 / 1', 'X.XX € de commissions cumulées · vous êtes en tête 🎉', and one best-month pill 'septembre 2026' with the total. The auto-email note '📧 Votre relevé est aussi envoyé automatiquement par email chaque début de mois.' is visible below the payout row. No React Native red screen, no page errors (only an unrelated 'API key not found' promise rejection from a Google-auth widget on the splash screen — does not affect the tested flows).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/company.py:265-284 request_payout — correct order of checks (amount<MIN → 422, amount>balance → 400), balance re-read from DB, negative credit_wallet call so wallet_tx type='payout' is recorded, and a db.payouts row is inserted with status='pending' plus moderator notifications. Clean.

routes/company.py:334-352 decide_payout — 404 on unknown id, 409 on non-pending status (guards double-decide), 'rejected' path refunds via credit_wallet(type='payout_refund') so the balance is restored AND an audit line appears in the statement, then updates the payout row. Correct and idempotent.

routes/company.py:288-314 partner_ranking — aggregates wallet_tx of type partner_commission only, computes rank via sorted board and returns len(board)+1 when partner never earned. Names are anonymized ('R•••') except for the current user ('Vous'). best_months groups by %Y-%m and returns top 3. Clean.

routes/company.py:356-375 public_statement_pdf — HMAC(JWT_SECRET, 'statement:{user_id}:{month}')[:32] compared with hmac.compare_digest — timing-safe. Returns 403 with generic 'Lien invalide' message; the month regex ^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$ blocks invalid months at the query level.

routes/company.py:379-399 monthly_statement_sweep — marks last_statement_month BEFORE sending so it stays idempotent even if the email fails, and skips users with no commission lines. Signed PDF link is built with the same statement_sig helper. Only concern: the sweep is imported by server.py; verify it is scheduled on a daily loop there (not in test scope).

frontend PayoutsAdmin.tsx — uses window.confirm on web and Alert.alert on native for the decision confirmation (good), catches errors and shows via window.alert on web. Filters are Pressable chips with testIDs; each card has payout-<id> plus payout-pay-<id> / payout-reject-<id> testIDs; visually clear pending/paid/rejected badges.

frontend PartnerCommissions.tsx:82-98 — the ranking card is gated on `ranking && ranking.my_total > 0` so partners with no commissions don't see a distracting '#N/A' block. The best-month pills gracefully wrap. The auto-email note is placed right under the payout controls, a good UX location.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested admin + ranking flows (PayoutsAdmin open, filters, pending list with pay/reject, paid decision refresh; PartnerCommissions comm-ranking with #rank, best-month pill, auto-email note)

seed_data_creation: The test_iteration20.py helper _ensure_hotel_balance created a few extra 'TEST_Iter20 Guest' partner bookings and simulated their completion (DB status=completed + distribute_partner_commission) to top up the hotel wallet above 30 € before running payout scenarios. During the run, 3 payouts of 10 € were created; 1 was marked paid via the admin PATCH endpoint, 1 was rejected (refunded), leaving 1 that was subsequently marked paid via the frontend UI test. Hotel.ritz@test.com now has ~22.84 € wallet balance and multiple payout rows (paid/rejected/paid) visible in the admin 'Toutes' filter for regression.
